decisions.scope: свой agreement examples and the source rule that свой follows the possessed object. себя and чтобы are not on this page.

Cardinal compounds, ordinal list forms, and nominative or inanimate-accusative noun-form examples. General numeral declension, оба, обе, полтора, полторы, collective numerals, and duration grammar are not established.
не placed before a verb, and есть replaced by нет. Accusative versus genitive under verbal negation, negative pronouns, and scope-sensitive placement are not established.
Existential absence stated as нет followed by the genitive. The accusative and genitive alternation under verbal negation is not established.

Personal-name structure, the source patronymic address example, listed full names, and the source-listed Latin diminutive pairs. Dated social, title, citizen, foreigner, creativity, and name-count claims are not shipped.
Source-listed please, thanks, apology, and formal-name question lines. Linked audio is not admitted.
Claims about people who do not deserve Comrade, wealthy foreigners, ordinary foreign citizens, a dozen names, and discouraged naming creativity stay out of learner-facing content.
MediaWiki audio links on the useful-words page are not admitted. No audio file, byte hash, or verified text match is retained.
No exact lexical row is required for these strands. Dictionary rows are not used to infer grammar.
The private owned PDF is an observation source only. Its prose, examples, exercises, and page images are not admitted.

Diverse Russian time ranges, beginning and middle expressions, during an event, duration throughout a period, and before, after, in, and ago, only where the retained chapter states them. This Pressbooks route is not a Wikipedia, Wiktionary, or Wikibooks license. A partial line does not clear elapsed-time-duration. The chapter does not state a completion-over-period distinction.

The Baltics travel grammar chapter states duration in the accusative and intended trip length with на plus the accusative. That contrast is not completion over a period. Its Pressbooks license route is separate from the USA grammar route and from Wikimedia routes. The chapter is retained and is not taught.
